name: gitstudio
displayName: GitStudio — JetBrains-style Git Graph, Blame & Merge
description: Free, open-source Git GUI & commit graph for VS Code and Cursor. Git Studio brings a JetBrains-style Git workflow into the editor — inline blame, file history, hunk & line staging, 3-pane merge, interactive rebase with universal Undo, stash/shelf, worktrees, and in-editor GitHub PRs. A free alternative to GitLens, GitKraken & Sourcetree.

badges.description: Also on Open VSX — Cursor, VSCodium, Windsurf, Gitpod
Apache-2.0 licensed — free on public and private repos

viewsWelcome.contents:
Work on multiple branches at once with linked worktrees.
[New Worktree](command:gitstudio.worktree.add)

Connect GitHub to review pull requests.
Sign in once with VS Code's built-in GitHub account to list, check out, review, merge, and create pull requests without leaving the editor.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:gitstudio.pr.signIn)

gitstudio.blame.inlineEnabled.description: Show inline blame for the current line (author, relative time, and summary) at the end of the line.

gitstudio.blame.statusBarEnabled.description: Show the current line's commit author and age in the status bar.

gitstudio.changesBadge.description: Show a count badge on the GitStudio activity-bar icon for changed files in the working tree (like the built-in Source Control badge). The tooltip also reports commits waiting to be pulled.

gitstudio.blame.clickOpensCommit.description: While blame annotations are shown, clicking one reveals that commit in the GitStudio Commit Graph, opened beside the code.

enumDescriptions: The commit's ordinal within this file's history (1 = oldest).

gitstudio.blame.gutter.fields.description: Which columns the blame annotation gutter shows. Configure them from the annotation right-click menu: Git Blame Annotations → Options.

gitstudio.blame.gutter.nameStyle.description: How author names are written in the blame annotation gutter.

enumDescriptions: Tint by commit age — a code-age heatmap (recent warmer, older cooler).
Give every author their own stable tint.
gitstudio.blame.gutter.colors.description: Background tint for the blame annotation gutter.

gitstudio.blame.showDiffOnHover.description: Show the commit behind a line — message, author, date, and a copyable SHA — when hovering it.

gitstudio.blame.heatmap.description: Tint full-file blame annotations with a code-age heatmap (recent changes warmer, older changes cooler).

gitstudio.merge.autoOpen.description: When a file becomes conflicted (during a merge, rebase, or cherry-pick), automatically open it in the GitStudio 3-pane merge editor.

gitstudio.commit.signoffByDefault.description: Enable the Sign-off toggle by default in the GitStudio commit box (adds a Signed-off-by trailer).

gitstudio.push.forceWithLease.description: When force-pushing from GitStudio, use the safer --force-with-lease (which refuses to overwrite remote work you haven't seen) instead of a raw --force.

enumDescriptions: Prefer the zero-key VS Code Language Model (GitHub Copilot / Cursor) when available; otherwise Anthropic (if a key is set), then an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (if a model is configured).
Use the VS Code Language Model API — GitHub Copilot or Cursor's models, with no key. Pick a specific model via “GitStudio: Select AI Model…”.
Use Anthropic directly (requires an API key set via GitStudio: Set AI API Key).
Use any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — OpenAI, Codex, OpenRouter, or a local server (Ollama / LM Studio). Configure the base URL and model below; a key is optional for local servers.
gitstudio.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Which provider GitBrain uses for optional AI features. AI is off until a provider is available; it never gates or breaks Git operations. Use **GitStudio: Select AI Model…** for a guided picker.

gitstudio.ai.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`/chat/completions` is appended). Examples: `https://api.openai.com/v1` (OpenAI), `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` (OpenRouter), `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama), `http://localhost:1234/v1` (LM Studio).

gitstudio.ai.openai.modelFast.description: OpenAI-compatible model ID for fast/cheap tasks (commit messages). For a local server use its model name, e.g. llama3.1 or qwen2.5-coder.

gitstudio.ai.openai.modelMid.description: OpenAI-compatible model ID for mid-tier tasks (explain diff, summaries).

gitstudio.ai.openai.modelDeep.description: OpenAI-compatible model ID for opt-in deep reasoning.

gitstudio.ai.anthropicModelFast.description: Anthropic model ID for fast/cheap tasks (commit messages).

gitstudio.ai.anthropicModelMid.description: Anthropic model ID for mid-tier tasks (explain diff, summaries).

gitstudio.ai.anthropicModelDeep.description: Anthropic model ID for opt-in deep reasoning.

enumDescriptions: A single concise subject line, no body.
Imperative subject plus a short explanatory body.
gitstudio.ai.commitStyle.description: How GitBrain styles generated commit messages.

gitstudio.ai.reviewPrompt.markdownDescription: Custom system prompt for **Review Changes (AI)**. Leave empty to use GitStudio's built-in code-review prompt. Set your own to steer the review (e.g. focus areas, house style, output format).

gitstudio.ai.cliAgent.description: The local agent CLI to drive (uses its own login, no API key). Set via the GitStudio · AI panel; used when the provider is a local agent.

gitstudio.ai.cliModel.description: Optional model override passed to the local agent CLI (blank = the CLI's default).

enumDescriptions: Squash the PR's commits into one and merge.
Rebase the PR's commits onto the base and merge.
gitstudio.pr.defaultMergeMethod.description: Default method offered first when merging a pull request.

gitstudio.errorReporting.enabled.markdownDescription: Send **anonymous, scrubbed crash reports** when a GitStudio command fails, so we can find and fix bugs during the beta without waiting for someone to file a report. No identity, repo contents, file names, commit messages, branch names, or remotes are ever collected — only the shape of a failure (error type/message/stack or the failed operation), tagged with a random install id and your OS/editor version. Reports are also gated by VS Code's global `telemetry.telemetryLevel`: set that to `off` to disable regardless of this toggle. Turn this off to opt out entirely.

gitstudio.errorReporting.endpoint.markdownDescription: Collector URL that anonymous crash reports are POSTed to as a plain JSON body. Defaults to GitStudio's collector; point it at any endpoint you control, or **leave it blank to disable sending entirely**. If unreachable, reporting silently no-ops.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with GitStudio
walkthroughs.description: A free, JetBrains-grade Git suite — commit graph, blame, history, hunk staging, 3-pane merge, interactive rebase with Undo, and optional BYO-key AI. Take the tour.

steps.title: Browse your history in the commit graph
steps.description:
Your history as a live, virtualized commit graph — right in the **Commits** view in the sidebar, or full-screen in an editor tab. Colored lanes, ref chips and authorship (never a flat list); right-click any commit to checkout, cherry-pick, branch, or reset, and compare any two branches.
[Open Commit Graph](command:gitstudio.showCommitGraph)
Tip: the graph lives in the **Commits** view at the top of the GitStudio sidebar — no need to leave it.

steps.title: Turn on inline blame
steps.description:
Ambient, native-feeling authorship: who last changed the current line and when, inline and in the status bar. Toggle full-file annotations with a code-age heatmap.
[Toggle File Blame](command:gitstudio.toggleFileBlame)
Shortcut: __Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+G B__ in any editor.

steps.title: Stage a hunk & commit
steps.description:
Stage by hunk or even by line, then commit from the GitStudio commit box (Amend, Sign-off, author override, Commit & Push). When AI is on, the ✨ button drafts a message from your staged diff.
[Open the Changes view](command:workbench.view.extension.gitstudio)
Shortcut: select lines and press __Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+G S__ to stage them.

steps.title: Explore file & line history
steps.description:
Step through how a file — or a single line — evolved over time, with revision navigation and a reflog time-machine for recovery.
[Show Line History](command:gitstudio.showLineHistory)
Shortcut: __Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+G H__ on the current line.

steps.title: Resolve conflicts in the 3-pane editor
steps.description:
When a merge, rebase, or cherry-pick conflicts, GitStudio opens a JetBrains-style three-pane editor — yours, the result, and theirs — with one-click accept ribbons. Interactive rebase gets the same care, wrapped in a universal, reflog-powered Undo.
[Start Interactive Rebase](command:gitstudio.startInteractiveRebase)
Made a mistake? __Undo Last Git Operation__ (Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+G Z) reverses it.

steps.title: Connect GitHub & set up GitBrain (optional)
steps.description:
Sign in once with VS Code's built-in GitHub account to list, check out, review, merge, and create pull requests in-editor. GitBrain AI is optional and bring-your-own-key — set an Anthropic key (or use Copilot's model) for commit messages, explain-this-diff, and summaries. It's off until you turn it on and never gates a Git operation.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:gitstudio.pr.signIn)
[Set AI API Key](command:gitstudio.ai.setApiKey)

virtualWorkspaces.description: GitStudio requires a local git repository on disk.
